sources.excerpt: Debut fantasy novel, first of the Harry Potter series (UK, 1997). Harry, an orphan, learns at 11 he is a wizard and attends Hogwarts, a school of magic, befriending Ron and Hermione. Set in England 1991-92. Reviewers noted its humour; Rowling channelled grief for her mother into the orphaned Harry. Filmed in 2001.
